title: Spacefabric API
description: Abstraction layer for world dimension management
body:
***This mod is currently being developed. Do NOT use it in your modpacks***

The Spacefabric API contains useful tools to manage dimensions at runtime. Other mods can use the public API to simplify some processes at runtime such as:

- Generating new dimensions
- Creating dimension types
- Customizing vanilla generators
- Adding biome entries and biome sources

### Planned features

- Unload worlds at runtime
- Delete saved worlds
- Mark created, saved, unloaded worlds as active or inactive
